title: Inverse RL Helps Align AI by Imitating Humans
abstract: arXiv:2607.24900v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language model alignment aims to make model behavior reflect desirable properties such as helpfulness, safety, and instruction following. Existing methods draw supervision from expert demonstrations, preference judgments, or verifiable outcomes. Demonstrations typically guide supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while preference judgments and verifiers provide rewards for reinforcement learning (RL). This raises a question: can the demonstrations alone be used to derive an explicit, interpretable reward useful in a post-training pipeline? Motivated by inverse reinforcement learning, we introduce Projected Alignment Reward Estimated from Demonstrations (PARED). PARED learns an explicit reward from expert demonstrations over a small set of response-level features, using a lightweight discriminator that separates demonstrations from the policy's own samples in this feature space. Experiments with inference-time reranking and adversarial on-pol

translated_title: 逆强化学习通过模仿人类帮助对齐AI
translated_abstract: 语言模型对齐旨在使模型行为反映出理想特性，如有用性、安全性和指令遵循。现有方法从专家演示、偏好判断或可验证结果中获取监督信号。专家演示通常用于指导监督微调（SFT），而偏好判断和验证器则为强化学习（RL）提供奖励。这引出了一个问题：能否仅凭演示数据推导出显式、可解释且可用于后训练流程的奖励？受逆强化学习的启发，我们提出了从演示中估计的投影对齐奖励（PARED）。PARED在一小组响应级特征上从专家演示中学习显式奖励，使用一个轻量级判别器在该特征空间中将专家演示与策略自身生成的样本区分开来。通过推理时重排序和对抗性在策略（实验验证）……
tldr: 提出PARED方法，受逆强化学习启发，仅从专家演示中学习显式且可解释的奖励函数，从而在没有偏好判断或验证器的情况下实现对语言模型的有效对齐。
en_tdlr: PARED leverages inverse reinforcement learning to learn an explicit, interpretable reward solely from expert demonstrations, enabling effective language model alignment without preference judgments or verifiers.
